drafts.angle: Revenue stack + QA step (rides @gregisenberg's '$1.4M ARR AI ad… Here's the stack', 601 bookmarks, 2x likes)
drafts.draft_en:
An AI ad can make $1.4M.
One bad AI ad can also get your ad account banned.

The stack everyone shares:
1. Voice clone
2. Video model
3. Upscale
4. Transcript check

The step nobody lists:
5. Check every frame and line against brand rules, claims law, and platform policy before it ships.

Step 4 is QA. Step 5 is what keeps you live.
drafts.video_tip: 25s vertical: show a numbered stack building up on screen (1-4), then a red 'step 5' card drops in, cut to real Aubric footage of a creative coming back APPROVE / FIX / BLOCK. Use only your own product footage and ads you own.

drafts.angle: Provenance counter-take (rides @gregisenberg's 'you'll never know AI made them', 155 replies on 38K)
drafts.draft_en:
"You'll never know AI made it" is fine for a song.

It's not fine for an ad.

An ad makes claims about a real product to real buyers, and regulators and platforms are already asking for AI disclosure.

If AI made your ad, someone should know. Start with you, before it ships.
drafts.video_tip: 12s text-on-screen: 'You'll never know AI made it' crossed out, replaced with 'Your ad platform will.' End on the last line. No stock faces, no fake ads.

drafts.angle: Blunt '99%' one-liner (rides @AlexHormozi's '99% of problems…', 237K and 3.2K bookmarks)
drafts.draft_en:
99% of AI ad mistakes are caught by one boring habit:

Check it before it ships, not after it's flagged.
drafts.video_tip: 8s vertical, two cuts: a creative getting a 'rejected' notice, then the same creative caught before publish with a FIX badge. Hold the line as text at the end.
